work.name: Circontrol

Integrated multiple protocol gateways (MQTT, Modbus, REST, gRPC) for device-agnostic control and monitoring
Hardened system reliability for continuous grid operations with emphasis on fault tolerance and data consistency

projects.name: AI-Powered Personal Health Assistant: Multi-Agent Framework for Wearable & Health Record Analysis
projects.summary: Implementing and evaluating a multi-agent system for personalized health insights, replicating Google's Personal Health Agent (PHA) architecture. Three coordinated specialist agents—data science, domain expert, health coach—process multimodal wearable and health record data. Focus on agentic orchestration, multi-source reasoning, and system evaluation in non-clinical health settings.
highlights: Multi-agent architecture with three specialist subagents
Orchestration framework integrating heterogeneous data sources (wearables, health records)
Evaluation methodology for multi-agent reasoning and reliability
Prototype implementation using general-purpose LLMs

projects.name: LLM-Based CV Processor System
projects.summary: Engineered an agentic LLM system for structured information extraction and document synthesis. Integrated document parsing, semantic understanding, and template-guided generation using LangChain and Python.
highlights: LLM orchestration with LangChain
Multi-step document processing pipeline
Structured output generation
PDF-to-DOCX workflow automation

projects.name: Autonomous Robot Navigation with Sensor Fusion
projects.summary: Designed a real-time motion control system integrating multi-sensor input (Kinect skeleton tracking, obstacle detection) with path planning algorithms for autonomous target following.
highlights: Real-time C++ motion control
Sensor fusion and skeleton tracking
Potential field-based path planning
Deterministic obstacle avoidance

projects.name: Switching Hybrid Recommender System for Music Platforms
projects.summary: Developed a hybrid recommendation engine addressing cold-start and sparse data challenges through dynamic user segmentation. Three coordinated strategies—popularity-based for new users, content-based for casual listeners, and collaborative filtering (SVD) for active users—optimize for discovery, engagement, and computational efficiency.
highlights: Hybrid approach with user segmentation and switching logic
Collaborative filtering via Matrix Factorization (SVD) achieving F1@k=0.502
Content-based similarity for diversity and catalog freshness
Handled sparse data and cold-start problem with adaptive ranking
